text: Describe and evaluate the elements of liability for a claim in respect of loss resulting from a
negligent misstatement. [25]
Explain the purpose of damages in the law of tort and assess the factors considered by a court
when calculating the amount of damages to be awarded. [25]
The tort of trespass to the person is no longer essential in the law of tort as a variety of alternative
actions are available to a claimant.
Explain the tort of trespass to the person and assess the validity of this statement. [25]
Section B
Navid is renovating his house. He hires Paulo to repair the roof. Navid also hires XTZ Ltd to erect
scaffolding and secure ladders around the building.
Paulo uses the scaffolding to access the roof and begins the repairs. After the first day of work
Paulo is descending from the roof by ladder, which becomes detached, and he falls to the ground.
Paulo sustains serious injuries and the ladder smashes the windscreen of his van.
Advise the parties as to their rights and responsibilities in this situation. [25]
Megan is driving home having collected her two children from school. Her car is hit by a van driven
by Darius, who is speeding on the wrong side of the road. Megan’s neighbour, Rania, witnesses
the collision and telephones Stefan, Megan’s husband. He rushes to the hospital and sees his
wife and children being taken from the ambulance.
Megan and the children sustain a variety of serious injuries. Rania has since been diagnosed
with depression and is receiving counselling. Stefan has been too upset to return to work.
Advise the parties as to their rights and responsibilities in this situation. [25]
Jasmine has a business selling fireworks online. She stores the fireworks in a wooden outbuilding
in her garden. During a severe storm the outbuilding is struck by lightning and the fireworks ignite.
Some fireworks land on the roof of a house nearby, setting it alight. The house is badly damaged
and the occupant, Kevin, sustains serious injuries.
Advise the parties as to their rights and responsibilities in this situation. [25]
